⚒ Ex Novo & Ex Umbra a play companion
Ex Novo & Ex Umbra are games by Martin Nerurkar & Konstantinos Dimopoulos — Sharkbomb Games (exnovo.sharkbombs.com / exumbra.sharkbombs.com).
This is an unofficial personal play aid. You need the rulebooks to get the full experience — this tool runs the dice, tables, cards and bookkeeping.
